children: Peru on Thursday rolled out a series of economic measures to fight a potential slowdown due to the impact of the El Niño weather phenomenon.

Impacted firms will receive liquidity injections and their tax payments will be deferred, Economy Minister Elmer Cuba said in a press conference, arguing Peru had the fiscal firepower to back such measures.
